tachyon-drive-core.title: The engine of expansion
tachyon-drive-core.alt: A cold blue drive chamber hangs inside heavy shielding and coolant pipes in an empty engineering bay.
tachyon-drive-core.caption: Tachyon Drive Cores enabled faster-than-light travel, but their radiation brought the Age of Unbirth.

wraithix.title: The fleet before the empire
wraithix.alt: Broken angular spacecraft and satellite fragments drift in a dark violet starfield.
wraithix.caption: The Wraithix derelicts predated Vallerii spaceflight. Their manifests pointed to Shadharam IV.

stellaris-superstructure.title: A star put to work
stellaris-superstructure.alt: Articulated golden collector panels enclose a brilliant star; a second sun shines in the distance.
stellaris-superstructure.caption: Built around one of Luminax's stars, the Stellaris Superstructure made the system the empire's solar capital.

mercurius-machine.title: The machine keeps printing
mercurius-machine.alt: Small circuit chips emerge from a precision machine onto a tray lit by warm task lights.
mercurius-machine.caption: The Mercurius Machine prints Scrambler Tokens: encrypted genomes that allow Generators to create plague-immune Xalians.
